canonical_title: Flight path response to designated flight path controller

versions.title_at_revision: Longitudinal response to the designated flight path controller
versions.text: Criterion: Verify that longitudinal response to the designated flight path controller is safe. Standard: The air vehicle meets the standards within the following MIL-STD-1797 paragraphs: a. 5.2.2.2 Longitudinal response to the designated flight path controller. b. 5.2.2.2.1 Flight path response to designated flight path controller (see figures 80 through 83 for guidance). c. 5.2.2.2.2 Flight path control power (see table XLIII for guidance). d. 5.2.2.2.3 Flight path controller characteristics. Method of Compliance: Verification methods include analysis, test, demonstration, simulation, and inspection of process, requirements, design, test, and configuration documentation.

versions.title_at_revision: Flight path response to designated flight path controller
versions.text:
Standard: The air vehicle flight path response to designated flight path controller is no worse than Level 2. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct analysis and simulation to assess the air vehicle's flight path response as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Flight Path Response to Designated Flight Path Controller paragraph for each combination of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct piloted simulation and evaluation to assess the air vehicle's flight path response as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Flight Path Response to Designated Flight Path Controller paragraph for each combination of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Conduct flight test to assess the air vehicle's flight path response as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Flight Path Response to Designated Flight Path Controller paragraph for selected combinations of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions.
